propositions: A new peer confirmation store must persist records of locally-created managed links with full metadata (link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, source) to distinguish peer-deleted links from never-pushed local links

The outbound link ADD success point in _update_one_dispatch_links must invoke an optional link_confirm callback after set_relationship returns, capturing the returned link_id and recording confirmation without perturbing link counts or failing the dispatch
The confirmation store must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames in reconcile_helpers to ensure confirmation-only changes are not silently dropped by the per-file idempotency guard
Unbound targets (where binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip confirmation recording entirely to avoid persisting vendor keys in local-id fields
A corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json file must degrade gracefully to an empty store without aborting the reconciliation pass
Any exception raised by the link_confirm callback must be logged and swallowed to ensure confirmation writes never fail an outbound link that already succeeded
